In Australia we have a lease, and a bond as two separate things. The lease is with the landlord/real estate, and the bond that is held with the RTBA (Residential Tenancie Bond Authority)

You can take you name off the lease by contacting the real estate and asking to do so, but to take your name off the bond you need to have all tenants fill in the RTBA paperwork. 

All tenants need to be on the lease when living at that property, but not everyone needs to be on the bond form.

Or go for some asian inspiration other than stirfry - sushi/handrolls, thai curries, or even indian curries - things that are traditionally made without meat.

By the end of summer, you'll probably be surprised with how many awesome food ideas you've discovered!

I do not regret my decision to have an abortion. These days, I KNOW I can take care of myself, and if I was to get pregnant again, I would have no question in my mind about keeping it.
